pagerbot: PAGER HIGH — unusual auth traffic from 198.51.100.23 hitting auth-proxy, repeated 401/403s then a spike of 200s with long response times. possible token scraping pattern. alert id: pager-1822223333
Nick O. (oncall): Got the page, I'm on it. tagging @Amir S. (sec) and @Jess R. (sre).
Amir S. (sec): Oncall Nick — can you snapshot recent logs and isolate IP? suspecting credential scraping or leaked log forwarder.
Jess R. (sre): Pulling logs now. quick check: origin shows repeated /v1/session/validate and /v1/internal/kvget at ~16:40 UTC, user-agent looks like curl/7.64.
Jess R. (sre): log snippet:
```
[2026-03-18T16:39:52Z] proxy.auth validate uid=svc-account-42 ip=198.51.100.23 ua="curl/7.64" status=200 latency=512ms
[2026-03-18T16:39:53Z] proxy.auth validate uid=svc-account-42 ip=198.51.100.23 ua="curl/7.64" status=200 latency=498ms
[2026-03-18T16:39:54Z] proxy.auth session_get uid=svc-account-42 token_frag=***REDACTED*** ip=198.51.100.23
```
Sasha L. (eng): That token_frag looks like repeated prefixes — could be a mirrored log sink leaking partial tokens. checking forwarding jobs.
Amir S. (sec): Immediate actions: 1) Block IP at WAF + infra ACLs 2) Revoke/rotate the service token for svc-account-42 3) Audit recent log forwarders for redaction failures. Prioritize step 2.
Jess R. (sre): Blocking IP now at edge WAF and internal firewall. applying temporary rate-limit on auth-proxy admin endpoints.
Jess R. (sre): WAF rule applied: `block ip 198.51.100.23` — confirmed in edge logs.
Sasha L. (eng): Runbook command to rotate token (using internal tool):
```
rbac rotate-service-token --service svc-account-42 --force --reason "suspected-exfil 1822223333"
```
Sasha L. (eng): I'll run the rotate and push new creds to Dedicated/Dynconfig. ETA ~7 minutes for rollout.
Amir S. (sec): Also start a scan for any S3 objects or ELK streams that contain `svc-account-42` in the last 48h. Leo, can you add an alert for high-extract patterns?
Leo (obs-eng): On it — creating a query to look for `svc-account-42`, token fragments, and `curl/7.64`. Will push a dashboard and short alert.
Maria (cust-success): Any customer impact? Do we need to notify customers who use svc-account-42?
Amir S. (sec): We don't have evidence of authenticated calls beyond the internal ID, but token fragments showing up in logs is PII/security-sensitive. Decide customer comms after rotation + quick forensic sweep.
Legal: Please avoid the term "breach" in external comms until we confirm exfiltration. Use neutral language: "investigating anomalous traffic".
Jess R. (sre): Rotation complete. new token deployed to prod. Verified auth-proxy rejects old token.
Sasha L. (eng): Rolling back any persistent log forwarders that failed redaction to `paused` state and starting scrub job on suspected buckets. Command run: `logsctl pause-forwarder --id forwarder-7`
Amir S. (sec): Forensics: pulled sample artifacts, forwarding them to sec-scan. No evidence yet of unauthorized data retrieval (requests returning 200 were validation-checks, not data reads).
Maria (cust-success): I'll draft a cautious customer note in case downstream vendors ask. Will coordinate wording with Legal.
Nick O. (oncall): Summary for pager: blocked IP, rotated svc token, paused potentially leaking forwarder, scan in progress. No confirmed customer data access.
Jess R. (sre): Opened INC-2026-1822223333 and assigned Sasha for postmortem and mitigation checklist.
Sasha L. (eng): Will file full incident report with timeline, root cause hypothesis (log-forwarder redaction bypass), mitigation steps, and remediation plan (stronger redaction, alerting).
Legal: We'll be on standby for any regulator/customer requests. keep me in loop.
Amir S. (sec): Next steps: complete scan (30m), validate no other svc tokens leaked, add stricter redaction in log pipeline, add rate-limit to validation endpoints.
Nick O. (oncall): Thanks team. continuing monitoring. will hand to oncall rotation after 2h if stable. :thumbsup:
Leo (obs-eng): Dashboards pushed. alert suppressed (now tracking).
Maria (cust-success): If anything changes, I'll trigger customer bridge. otherwise prepping templates.
Sasha L. (eng): will attach artifacts to INC ticket and schedule postmortem session. closing slack thread after handoff.
Nick O. (oncall): closing for now — escalate immediately if new IPs or 401->200 patterns reappear. :rotating_light:
